Vanilla Pound Cake Recipe [Paleo, Gluten-Free]
By: Paleo Flourish
Published: Thursday, July 19, 2018 - 11:47pm

Ingredients




3 cups almond flour
1/3 cup pure whey protein powder
1 and 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1 teaspoon baking soda
Pinch of salt
1/2 cup of ghee, softened
3 large eggs
1 tablespoon vanilla extract (sugar-free)
4 Tablespoons honey
Stevia equivalent to 1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup almond milk

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 300F (150C). 2 Butter a loaf pan (9in-by-5in). 3 Mix all the ingredients together well. 4 Pour the batter into the loaf pan and bake for 60 minutes (the cake will rise in the oven and the top should turn golden brown). Let the cake cool for a few minutes before flipping it out. Cut into slices when it’s completely cooled.

About

DESCRIPTION: Enjoy some Paleo and gluten-free cake that's moist and delicious.
